description: Image Description: The image shows a bathroom scene centered around a white toilet with a closed lid. On the left side of the toilet, two rolls of toilet paper are mounted on a dual-tiered metal holder. The top roll is fully intact and positioned horizontally, while the bottom roll appears partially used, with a visible section of the cardboard tube. The toilet tank has a silver flush handle on the right side, and a small yellow rubber duck sticker is affixed near the lower right corner of the tank
